newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Markets remain subdued.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Markets remain subdued.

text.p: Millfeed markets remained quiet as many dealers face a shortened week after a long weekend.
"There are no trades yet. Everybody is settling down after the Labor Day holiday," a Texas broker said.
Millfeed values on Tuesday were mixed.
Nearby supplies were tight in the central U.S. as seen by the premium prices quoted for prompt shipment versus deferred positions.
One St Louis dealer said the market seemed to be on solid footing but noted "there was no real trading."
But demand for millfeed picked up in Minnesota as well as southern California which was supported by shorter mill run times, dealers said.
